scope: Six heroic instance spawn lists; all eligible mobs from DUNGEON_MOBS/TEMPLE_DUNGEON_MOBS/WILDHEART_MOBS; static literal base loot only
notes: The actual runtime generator filters quality and equippable kind, produces 'heroic_'+id, adjusts stats/rating with item_budget; the data here does not execute TypeScript/runtime.
ClaudeCraft heroic quality is NOT HIGHFLY enhancement. Any adaptation creates plus 0 gear regardless quality.
No existing HIGHFLY code or asset has been modified.
Nythraxis 28 weighted epic + 2 reserved legendary base IDs were previously hidden in `...NYTHRAXIS_EQUIPMENT_LOOT`; they are now reconciled and inserted.
Five-man source 25 is used if heroic boss table explicitly references generated variant; raid source 27 takes precedence.
